sw_butcher.text: Black pudding, white pudding, lamb, a bit of mutton and a sausage with a name. Oatmeal, suet, onion and blood. It's all in the seasoning, and I'll not be telling you what's in the seasoning.
Most of the pudding goes into the 'full breakfast'. We do not do a half one. Two rounds of black pudding, two eggs, tomato, bacon and a potato scone. And mushrooms, for the look of it.
